title: Open Semantic Agent Notification Data (SPEC 0.5 §6.12)
description: The data of an envelope whose content_type is application/vnd.osa.notification+json: a record of one attempt to tell a person about an envelope. $defs.payload is the message a push service carries to the device (§9.4).

notification.description: The kind of thing notified, normally the alert or recommendation kind, for example disk.falling

state.description: sent: handed to the channel; failed: the channel refused it; acknowledged: the person opened it or answered it; expired: no answer before the escalation time

recipient.description: A contact URI the implementation resolves. Never an address, a phone number, a device token or a push subscription.

for.description: The dedupe_key of the alert, or the id of the envelope, this notification is about

escalation.description: 0 for the first recipient, 1 for the first escalation, and so on

answer.description: Only with state acknowledged: what the person did from the notification

taken.description: Only with answer done: the index of the recommended action the person marked done

error.description: Only with state failed: the channel's reason, without addresses or tokens

payload.title: Notification payload (§9.4)
payload.description: What the push service carries to the device. At most 3000 bytes as UTF-8 JSON, so it fits every channel after encryption.

envelope.description: The id of the envelope notified; the app fetches the rest with history (§9.1) under its own clearance

recommendation.description: The id of the open recommendation (§6.11)

action.description: The top action's text. Never its command.

answers.description: Buttons the device may offer; each answer is reported back as an acknowledged notification and, for advice, a recommendation state change

url.description: Where a tap opens, on the implementation's own origin
